audit.why: EVEN 6/10 matches 46.32% over 557 games with Poppy owning levels 2-3 and Rumble only clearly ahead at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike claims 'Poppy's Iceborn Gauntlet spike empowers her Q shockwave', and the level-6 spike never says what Keeper's Verdict does or costs.
audit.why: Hammer Shock is a slow zone that explodes after a delay — nothing about it is a shockwave an item empowers, and I cannot verify an Iceborn Gauntlet build from local data. Meanwhile Keeper's Verdict is a channelled knockup on 140 seconds at rank 1, which is LONGER than your 130-second Equalizer — you out-cycle her ultimate, and that is the real level-6 story.
audit.corrected: Item claim generalised to a first-item spike, and the 140s-versus-130s ultimate comparison added at level 6.
sources: champ-data/_kits/poppy.json (Q Hammer Shock; R Keeper's Verdict, channel, cd 140/120/100)

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fabrications, all repeated. (a) 'Poppy's passive Valiant Fighter shield' appears in early, whys[0] and wants.foe[2]. (b) 'Q knockup' appears five times — spikes[0], early, wants.foe[0], whys[0], whys[2] and late. (c) Steadfast Presence is described as blocking your peel and stopping your Flamespitter approach.
audit.why: (a) Poppy's passive is Iron Ambassador: she throws a buckler that bounces off the target and she must WALK OVER IT to gain the shield. It is not a passive damage filter — so standing on the buckler, or simply making her step out of lane to fetch it, denies the shield entirely. Nothing on the page told the player the shield is a pickup. (b) Hammer Shock has no knockup; it is a slow zone that explodes after a delay. The only knockup Poppy owns is Keeper's Verdict. A Rumble player told to fear a level-1 Q knockup plays the wrong spacing all lane. (c) Steadfast Presence stops enemy DASHES around her, then slows and grounds whoever dashed — Rumble has no dash, so that half of her W is dead weight in this matchup. What actually matters is its passive armour and MR, which INCREASE as she drops low: that is why your Danger Zone burst keeps failing to finish her, and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: Iron Ambassador and its pickup named, every 'Q knockup' replaced with the slow zone, and Steadfast Presence rewritten around the low-health resist scaling plus the fact its dash-stop does nothing to you.
sources: champ-data/_kits/poppy.json (P Iron Ambassador; Q Hammer Shock: 'a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay'; W Steadfast Presence: armour/MR that increases at low health, stops enemy dashes; E Heroic Charge: dash + wall stun; R Keeper's Verdict)

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown number appears on the page.
audit.why: Heroic Charge at 14s is the wall-stun window the whole page tells the player to track, Steadfast Presence is 20s at rank 1, and Hammer Shock is 8s. Without them 'track Heroic Charge' is unactionable.
audit.corrected: 14s, 20s and 8s written into the cooldown breakdown and the Do entry; 14s also into wants.you[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Poppy 'him' and 'his' in breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.trading and dontsFull[0].d.
audit.why: Wrong pronoun throughout a champion page.
audit.corrected: Fixed in breakdown.mid and dontsFull[0].d; the rest flagged in notes.

edits.before: At level 1 it is genuinely even — Poppy's passive Valiant Fighter shield eats a meaningful chunk of your Flamespitter damage and she can Q-zone you off the wave without giving you a clean trade. Do not walk straight at her; angle your Q cone from the side so you don't walk directly into her Q knockup path. Play the minion wave rather than forcing a trade. At level 2 she gets Steadfast Presence and can walk into your Flamespitter with the shield absorbing your peak burst, and by level 3 her full kit — Q into E wall-stun — means she can lock you into a wall while you're in Overheat silence and delete a full health bar. Keep the wave in front of your tower so the wall behind you is your tower, not the side terrain, and use your double Electro-Harpoon slow to stop her from walking you into corner geometry.
edits.after: At level 1 it is genuinely even — Iron Ambassador throws a buckler she has to walk over to get the shield — stand on it or push her off it and she gets nothing. Hammer Shock has no knockup; it is a slow zone that explodes after a delay, so step out of the circle rather than backing off the wave. Play the minion wave rather than forcing a trade. At level 2 she gets Steadfast Presence and can walk into your Flamespitter with the shield absorbing your peak burst, and by level 3 her full kit — Hammer Shock zone into a 14-second Heroic Charge wall-stun — can lock you into terrain while Overheat silences you. Keep the wave in front of your tower so the wall behind you is your tower, not the side terrain, and use your double Electro-Harpoon slow to stop her from walking you into corner geometry.

edits.before: Poppy's full kit — Q knockup into E wall-stun — comes online and she can punish your Overheat silence with a hard CC chain before you can W shield.
edits.after: Her full kit — Hammer Shock slow zone into a 14s Heroic Charge wall-stun — is online, and she punishes your Overheat silence before you can W shield.

edits.before: Your Equalizer arrives: even if Poppy has won the 1v1, a well-aimed Equalizer across a river skirmish or herald fight keeps you relevant and buys leverage to reset the lane.
edits.after: Your Equalizer arrives on 130 seconds against her 140-second Keeper's Verdict — you out-cycle her ultimate, so even a lost 1v1 leaves you the bigger threat at every river skirmish.

edits.before: Poppy's Iceborn Gauntlet spike empowers her Q shockwave and makes extended trades even harder — she has the stats to walk through your Flamespitter and CC you through it.
edits.after: Poppy's first-item spike hurts because Steadfast Presence gives more armour and MR the lower she gets — she has the stats to walk through Flamespitter and CC you inside it.

edits.before: Poppy's passive Valiant Fighter shield cuts into your unempowered Q damage and her Q threatens a knockup if you walk straight in — neither of you wins a clean level 1 trade.
edits.after: Iron Ambassador only shields her if she walks over the thrown buckler, and Hammer Shock is a slow zone rather than a knockup — neither of you wins a clean level 1 trade.

edits.after: With all three abilities plus wall geometry she zones you with Hammer Shock then Heroic Charges you into terrain while Overheat silences you — a 14s combo she lacks before 3.

edits.after: Walk you into terrain with Heroic Charge for the wall-stun, then drop Hammer Shock on top of you

notes: Steadfast Presence's dash-stop is irrelevant here because Rumble's kit contains no dash — the full layer's tldr 'her W doesn't stop flame' happens to be true but for the wrong reason, and I left it because the correction does not fit the length band. Remaining wrong-pronoun references to Poppy in the full layer: breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.trading ('double-E slow if he runs'), breakdown.late. The Iceborn Gauntlet claim I removed from the first-item spike still appears in whys[5]; I could not verify Poppy's current item trend from local data, so I left that instance rather than guess. Keeper's Verdict is a channel — whether Rumble can interrupt it is not answerable from the kit file, so no claim was made.
